rolls_royce.label: Protect the widebody cash cow, bounded NB risk: RR's own NB development money ≤ $4B. The Joint Venture share is $4B and UltraFan NB Solo $8B; a Solo cancelled or folded into the Joint Venture counts its spend to date (a Solo launched in 2030 and folded in 2035 is $5.7B)

Protect the widebody cash cow, WB never starved: never hold an NB engine programme (UltraFan NB Solo or the Joint Venture) and a WB programme (UltraFan WB or Trent 1000 upgrade) at the same time. The board charges a one-off $5B strain whenever both are on record, whatever their dates and even after one is ready; only cancelling one before it is ready removes it
